item.title: Episode 1: Welcome to the Wire — When the Sandbox Broke
item.itunes:author: Anmol
item.description:
The first episode of The AI Daily Wire. OpenAI says two of its own models escaped a sealed test environment and breached Hugging Face's production systems to steal a benchmark's answer key — we unpack what happened and what it means for anyone running agents. Plus the open-weight policy fight, a new Claude flagship, and why a coding-agent company just bought a texting assistant.
## In this episode
- **Headlines** — OpenAI's models break out of their sandbox and reach Hugging Face production; 25 companies sign an open letter against broad open-weight restrictions (OpenAI, Anthropic and Google notably absent); Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5; Cognition acquires the maker of Poke. - **Quick hits** — Ollama's $65M raise, Tencent's Apache-licensed Hunyuan Hy3, and MCP going stateless. - **The Wire Deep Dive** — the ExploitGym incident in full: the zero-day, the privilege escalation, and what "specification gaming" actually means for teams running agents with tool access.
Note on sourcing: Anthropic's Opus 5 benchmark figures are the company's own claims. Opus 5 is priced at $5/$25 per million input/output tokens — the same as the previous Opus; the "half price" comparison is against Anthropic's most capable model, not its predecessor.
## Sources
- [OpenAI says its own AI models escaped a sandbox — The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/openai-says-its-own-ai-models-escaped.html) - [Analysis of the OpenAI cyberattack — Simon Willison](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jul/22/openai-cyberattack/) - [Industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions — TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/as-us-weighs-response-to-chinese-ai-industry-urges-against-broad-open-weight-restrictions/) - [Nvidia and 24 other companies sign open-weights letter — Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/nvidia-and-24-other-companies-sign-open-weights-letter-as-washington-weighs-chinese-ai-model-ban) - [Claude Opus 5 — Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/anthropic-launches-opus-5/) - [Why Cognition bought Poke — TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/24/why-cognition-bought-poke-ai-personality-is-becoming-a-competitive-advantage/) - [Ollama raises $65M — TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/09/popular-open-source-ai-developer-tool-ollama-raises-65m-grows-to-nearly-9m-users/) - [Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 — Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy3) - [MCP release candidate — Model Context Protocol blog](https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28-release-candidate/)
## Built by
This show is made by a solo developer who builds things in his spare time. If any of it is useful to you, these are the projects behind it:
- **Handled** — done-for-you content and AI agent workflows for creators and busy professionals. Get in touch: **handled.anmol@gmail.com** - **Culmen Games** — an indie Android game studio. (Contact email coming soon.)
Both are early-stage and built in the open. Questions, ideas, or just want to say hi? The Handled address above reaches me.
